resources.string: Swipe up or down to choose a mode, then double-tap to turn it on or off
Point the rear camera at what you want described. For Point and Speak, point a finger at text in the camera view. Descriptions can be wrong. Don\'t rely on them to move around safely.

Scenes, Point and Speak, People detection and Door detection send an image from the camera to Google\'s Gemini API every few seconds. Text is recognised on this phone.\n\nWith a free API key, Google may keep what it receives, use it to improve its products, and have people review it. Generative AI is experimental, so it will make mistakes.
